reason: Fix approved by the owner on 24 October 2026: web/app.js startExam() takes one Date.now() reading for both startedAt and endsAt. The two separate readings could straddle a millisecond, so endsAt - startedAt was occasionally 75 minutes plus 1 ms; tests/app.test.cjs asserts the exact length and failed intermittently (the first Release run for v1.13.3 failed this way and was re-run). The exam's questions, drawing, answers, scoring, storage keys and every other behaviour are unchanged; the single-file app is regenerated from the same sources. CHANGELOG.md gains the bilingual Unreleased bullets. The question bank, answers, quotes, notes and source originals are unchanged.
